truths.CP2:
WITH order_days AS (
  -- one row per order, with its day on Amsterdam's clock
  SELECT order_id,
         CASE WHEN channel = 'web'
              THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE)
              ELSE CAST(order_ts AS DATE) END AS order_day
  FROM orders
),
lines AS (
  -- one row per line of an order placed in 2024, as stored, numbered within each set of copies
  SELECT ol.unit_price_eur, p.unit_cost_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
                            ORDER BY ol.order_line_id) AS copy_no
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN order_days AS d ON d.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE d.order_day >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND d.order_day < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM lines
WHERE copy_no > 1
   OR unit_price_eur > 10 * unit_cost_eur
truths.CP4:
WITH order_days AS (
  -- one row per order, with its day on Amsterdam's clock
  SELECT order_id,
         CASE WHEN channel = 'web'
              THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) AS DATE)
              ELSE CAST(order_ts AS DATE) END AS order_day
  FROM orders
),
lines AS (
  -- one row per line of an order placed in 2024, as stored, numbered within each set of copies
  SELECT ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.line_discount_eur, p.unit_cost_eur,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ol.order_id, ol.product_id, ol.quantity, ol.unit_price_eur, ol.promo_id, ol.line_discount_eur
                            ORDER BY ol.order_line_id) AS copy_no
  FROM order_lines AS ol
  JOIN order_days AS d ON d.order_id = ol.order_id
  JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
  WHERE d.order_day >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND d.order_day < DATE '2025-01-01'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(line_discount_eur)
             / SUM(quantity * CASE WHEN unit_price_eur > 10 * unit_cost_eur THEN unit_price_eur * 0.01 ELSE unit_price_eur END), 2)
FROM lines
WHERE copy_no = 1

CP1.explanation: Depth divides a month's discounts by the gross value of all its sales, so every line counts, each copy once and in euros, and a web order's UTC time must become Amsterdam time first, since a late-evening order can belong to the next month; leaving out the lines with no promotion drops the full-price sales the depth is measured against.

CP5.explanation: The depth divides all of a month's discounts by all of its gross value, sales with no promotion included, so it measures how much was given away overall rather than the size of a typical promotion, and counting each copy once does not change what it measures.
